hull_geometry: Long, spindle-shaped central core with three sets of outrigger nacelles mounted on slender pylons in a tripod configuration
materials_and_finish: Fine, micro-etched hull plating with complex circuitry-like patterns; engines emit a stable, high-energy blue-white plasma glow
design_philosophy: Suggests high maneuverability and advanced warp dynamics; the outrigger nacelles provide a wide-area field projection
color_scheme: Dark charcoal-grey matte finish; glowing cyan power conduits run the entire length of the hull like a nervous system
distinctive_traits: The thin pylons and separated hulls indicate advanced structural integrity fields or exotic lightweight alloys
